headline: A 2021 executive order from President Biden directs federal action aimed at making it easier for eligible Americans to vote.
what_it_does: This executive order is titled "Promoting Access to Voting." Based on the title, it directs the federal government to take steps related to helping eligible people register and vote. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at making voting more accessible to them, though the specific steps are not described in the source material.
Executive orders direct the work of the executive branch, so agencies may be told to take voting-related actions.
